clue.text: Premier rank?

definitions.meaning: premier as an adjective means chief or principal

explanation.definitionFit: Both a leading thing and an army officer's grade share this word: main or chief, and the officer between captain and lieutenant colonel.

clue.text: Loud Verdi composition full of fire and passion

parts.note: F, forte, is the musical marking for loud

indicators.note: a composition puts things together in a new arrangement, so the composer's name is rearranged

explanation.surface: A thunderous piece by the Italian opera composer brims with ardour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composition' is the anagram signal, borrowing the musical sense to suit the composer's name; F for loud is the musical marking forte.
explanation.definitionFit: Fervid is a synonym of ardent or impassioned, burning with intense feeling.

clue.text: WWII bomber in battle

definitions.meaning: the Bristol ... was a British light bomber of the Second World War
the 1704 victory of Marlborough in Bavaria

explanation.definitionFit: The same name belongs to a British wartime aircraft and to Marlborough's famous 1704 victory over the French.

clue.text: She plays with the electricity switch

parts.note: AC, alternating current, stands for electricity
a switch is a lock or tress of hair

explanation.surface: A woman fiddles with the light switch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'switch' is not a light switch but a hank of hair, a TRESS.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman who performs roles on stage or screen plays parts, which is what this performer does.

clue.text: Tap observed to be crooked

parts.note: a cock is a tap or valve controlling flow

explanation.surface: A faucet was watched and found to be bent.
explanation.definitionFit: Something askew or out of line is said to be skew-whiff or crooked, the informal sense of this compound.

clue.text: About to teach the others self-control

indicators.note: about here means going round, so the word for the others surrounds the word for teach

explanation.surface: Someone is about to instruct the remaining people in discipline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About' looks like 'on the point of', but it is the container signal: the others go round the word for teach.
explanation.definitionFit: Restraint is the holding back of one's impulses, a synonym of self-discipline.

clue.text: Happen to finish in the first three

definitions.meaning: in a race, to be placed, i.e. take a place among the top finishers

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means occur, and read literally it means to secure a placing, first to third, in a race.

clue.text: Conceal or report a story

definitions.meaning: a journalist ... a news story by reporting on it

explanation.definitionFit: To hide something is to put a lid over it, and a reporter assigned to an event is said to handle it in this sense.

clue.text: Scheme that is little short of perfect

indicators.note: a little short of means falling just short, so the word for perfect loses its final letter

explanation.surface: A plan that is nearly flawless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'little short of' looks like 'almost', but it trims the last letter from IDEAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A scheme is a plan, and a plan is a notion or concept in one's mind.

clue.text: Strange virus one may pick up on holiday

indicators.note: strange signals the letters are turned into an odd new arrangement

explanation.surface: An odd bug that a traveller might catch while abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strange' rearranges the letters of VIRUS ONE; 'one' is both fodder and the subject of the definition in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A keepsake bought as a reminder of a trip is something a tourist picks up while away.

clue.text: Knock out some facts about aircraft

indicators.note: about means going round, so the word for facts surrounds the knockout letters

parts.note: KO is the boxing abbreviation for knockout

explanation.surface: Some figures on planes deliver a decisive blow.
explanation.definitionFit: The Douglas Dakota was a famous transport plane, the military version of the DC-3.

clue.text: A slack return in fielding

indicators.note: a return comes back, so the letters run backwards
in says the letters sit inside the word fielding

explanation.surface: A lazy throw back from the field in cricket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' points inside 'fielding' for ELDI, and 'return' reads it backwards. A return is also a fielder's throw back to the wicket in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: Slack and lazy are synonyms, both describing someone inactive or not working.

clue.text: Leash may become twisted around a dog

indicators.note: become twisted says the letters are wrung into a new order

explanation.surface: A lead can get tangled around a pet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'become twisted' rearranges LEASH MAY; 'may' is fodder, not a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A Sealyham is a Welsh breed of short-legged terrier.

clue.text: They have to make cuts in this business

definitions.text: They have to make cuts in this business

parts.words: They have to make cuts in this business
parts.note: sounds like a company cutting costs, but means the trade where cloth is cut to make suits

explanation.definitionFit: Making clothes to measure is a trade in which cloth must be cut, which is the craft of a bespoke suit-maker.

clue.text: Tide may change between sunrise and sunset

indicators.note: to change these letters is to put them into a different order

explanation.surface: The sea level may shift over the course of the light hours.
explanation.definitionFit: The hours of light, from dawn to dusk, are the part of the day opposed to night.

clue.text: It's a man shipwrecked on a Pacific isle?

indicators.note: a shipwreck breaks things up, so these letters are broken and reassembled

explanation.surface: A castaway washes up on an island in the ocean.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shipwrecked' rearranges ITSAMAN plus the second A. The question mark admits the island lies south of Australia, between the Tasman Sea and the Southern Ocean, not strictly in the Pacific.
explanation.definitionFit: An Australian island state off the south coast of the mainland, washed by the Tasman Sea, an arm of the Pacific.

clue.text: A diner's ordered fish

indicators.note: ordered here means put in a new order, not requested from a menu

explanation.surface: A restaurant customer's request is a seafood dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordered' looks like a diner placing an order, but it rearranges A DINERS.
explanation.definitionFit: The sardine is a small oily fish of the herring family, often sold tinned.

clue.text: A literary supplement?

parts.note: sounds like a newspaper's books section, but means extra material appended to a written work

explanation.definitionFit: An appendix of extra matter added at the end of a book or document supplements the text.

clue.text: Go on-take legal action

definitions.meaning: to ... against someone is to sue them

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means continue onward, and in law to start a case against someone.

clue.text: For which one needs to be in fighting form?

definitions.text: For which one needs to be in fighting form?

parts.words: For which one needs to be in fighting form?
parts.note: fighting form suggests physical fitness, but form here is a social stratum, so this is conflict between social strata

explanation.definitionFit: Conflict between social strata, as in Marxist theory, needs people to fight on behalf of their social group.

clue.text: Flier, no longer in the navy

definitions.meaning: a member of the former Women's Royal Naval Service, absorbed into the Royal Navy in 1993

explanation.definitionFit: The tiny brown songbird shares its name with a woman of the old Women's Royal Naval Service, now merged into the regular fleet.

clue.text: The old way round to the squirrel's nest

indicators.note: round means turned about, so the two pieces together are read backwards

parts.note: ye is an old form of the
RD is the abbreviation for road, a way

explanation.surface: An old route goes around to where a squirrel lives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' turns both pieces as one run; YE is the old spelling of 'the' seen on mock-antique shop signs.
explanation.definitionFit: A drey is the twiggy nest that a squirrel builds in a tree.

clue.text: Pass directions around the circuit

indicators.note: around says the compass letters surround the word for circuit

parts.note: ESE, east-south-east, combines the directions E and SE
a lap is one circuit of a track

explanation.surface: Compass bearings are given round a racetrack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' is the container; 'directions' is plural because east-south-east joins two compass points.
explanation.definitionFit: When time goes by, it is said to slip away or pass.

clue.text: Evidence of spiritual strength

definitions.meaning: the alcoholic strength of spirits, measured on a scale such as 70 degrees

explanation.definitionFit: The word means conclusive demonstration, and also the scale giving the alcohol content of distilled spirits.

clue.text: Where the batsman stands about in case

indicators.note: in says one piece sits inside the word case

explanation.surface: A cricketer takes his position just in case.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the crease is the white line at each end of the pitch where the batsman stands; 'about' is the usual crossword word for RE.
explanation.definitionFit: The batting crease is the line in front of the stumps marking the batter's ground in cricket.

clue.text: Wild Etruscan horsemen

indicators.note: wild means unruly, so these letters run riot into a new order

explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the creatures that are half man, half horse are literally horse-men.

clue.text: Pest possibly slain in the garden

indicators.note: possibly suggests another arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: A garden pest might be killed among the flowerbeds.
explanation.definitionFit: A slow shelled mollusc that eats garden plants is a common pest for gardeners.

clue.text: So evil, run out showing disgust

indicators.note: out means disordered or wrong, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Such wickedness, get away, shows loathing.
explanation.definitionFit: Revulsion is a strong feeling of loathing or repugnance.
